name: Silvio Wenzel
original_name: シルヴィオ・ヴェンゼル
source:
Kia's target.

He is a thief who has postwar Germany in an uproar. The face concealed beneath his mask is quite handsome. He is trying to assemble a collection of artwork that was scattered during the war.

[From in-game profile]
